subtitle.en: Source: dotbitHQ/did-contracts @0cc9fbf contracts/reverse-record-cell-type ("sync the source code from latest deployed contracts")

cond.zh: 从输入 #0 起连续，之后没有其他输入
所有输入的 lock 相同
lock = L 的 BalanceCell 输出容量 ≥ Σ 输入 − common_fee（配置，未检查）
cond.en: BalanceCell outputs with lock L hold ≥ Σ inputs − common_fee (config, not checked)

notes.zh: 部署：code hash 是 Type ID 脚本哈希；type-id args 来自 dotbitHQ/das-lib core/env.go（主网 0x000f3e1a…，测试网 Testnet2 0x334d7841…），主网与测试网都已在链上看到活的 code cell 和交易。
notes.en: Deployment: the code hash is the Type ID script hash; type-id args come from dotbitHQ/das-lib core/env.go (mainnet 0x000f3e1a…, testnet Testnet2 0x334d7841…); live code cells and txs seen on both networks.

notes.zh: Type ID 合约可升级：主网 code cell 已多次替换。所读源码是 0cc9fbf（官方注明从最新部署合约同步），未做可复现构建。
notes.en: Type ID contracts are upgradable: the mainnet code cell has been replaced several times. The source read is 0cc9fbf (officially described as synced from the latest deployed contracts); no reproducible build.

notes.zh: 早期部署的二进制还支持 declare_reverse_record / redeclare_reverse_record（链上有这类交易）；当前源码对它们返回 27，解码器对这类交易显示为未检查。
notes.en: Earlier deployed binaries also supported declare_reverse_record / redeclare_reverse_record (such txs exist on chain); the current source returns 27 for them, and the decoder shows those txs as not checked.

notes.zh: 系统开关、BalanceCell type id 和 common_fee 都来自 cell_deps 里的 ConfigCell，解码器不加载 cell_deps 数据，所以这些项未检查。
notes.en: The system switch, BalanceCell type id and common_fee come from ConfigCells in cell_deps; the decoder does not load cell_dep data, so these are not checked.

notes.zh: 错误码（das-core error.rs）：-1 SystemOff · 6 InvalidTransactionStructure · 27 ActionNotSupported · 34 ChangeError · 46 WitnessDataDecodingError
notes.en: Error codes (das-core error.rs): -1 SystemOff · 6 InvalidTransactionStructure · 27 ActionNotSupported · 34 ChangeError · 46 WitnessDataDecodingError
